specificSetting: a family holiday by train planning brief 17

tasks.scenario: Class helping to plan a family train holiday; email from teacher asking about priorities (cost vs comfort), a practical choice (book seats together vs plan a stop), and a fun activity for children.
tasks.purpose: Evaluate and justify priorities: choose between cost and comfort, select a practical arrangement, suggest children's entertainment, and ask about the date.
requiredContentPoints: Say which is more important: low cost OR comfort – and explain why.
Choose a practical thing to organise (book seats together OR plan a stop) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to make the journey fun for children.
Ask Mrs. Hill about the date of the holiday.
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Scenario is unique: family holiday by train planning, not used in any previous test. Email from teacher about class project. Notes panel with four distinct points including a choice between two options. No forbidden concepts.

tasks.scenario: Travel website for families asking for articles about train travel with family – good points and difficulties.
tasks.audience: Readers of a family travel website
tasks.purpose: Assess effectiveness and recommend: give opinion on train travel for families, describe best thing and possible difficulties.
requiredContentPoints: Is a train journey a good way for a family to travel on holiday?
What is the best thing about it?
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Article prompt about family train travel, not used before. Two direct questions plus an overall opinion. No generic phrases. No forbidden concepts.

tasks.scenario: Story beginning with a train stopping suddenly between stations.
tasks.purpose: Continue a story from a given opening sentence about an unexpected train stop.
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Opening sentence is unique: train stopping between stations, not used in any previous test. No cliché. Forbidden concepts check passed.

overallOriginalityCheck: All tasks are original, use concrete scenarios from the design fingerprint, avoid forbidden concepts, and do not reuse skeletons from previous tests.
